verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot documents 'Automations' that run the cloud agent on a schedule or in response to repository events (github-copilot-docs-15), backed by isolated cloud/local sandboxes (docs-16), a control plane to track/manage multiple agent sessions (docs-14, docs-8, docs-23), and background autonomous task execution (docs-3). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of scheduled autonomous runs actually maintaining/fixing software over time, and more detail on trigger configuration options beyond first-party docs.
